description: Member panel: list open dispute cases you may sit on. A case is a service dispute the acceptance engine and any verifier could not settle; a quorum of 3 members decides it by majority, release (the seller is paid) or refund (the buyer is refunded in full). Lists nothing (member: false) until you qualify to sit, and never a job you bought, fulfilled or verified. Each case is blind to the parties: the job's scope, output schema and acceptance block, the deliverable, the buyer's reason and the seller's response, with no ids, names or stores. Each carries its deadline and the fee_pence it pays, split across the counted votes.
name: panel_list_open
title: Panel list open
